name: finance_settlement_constraints
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0017') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_treasuries') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'pk_treasuries' AND contype = 'p') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_receipts__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_disbursements__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_treasury_transfers__branch_document' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_receipts__treasury_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_disbursements__treasury_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'fk_financial_movements__treasury_branch' AND contype = 'f') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_financial_allocations__source_target' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_customer_advances__receipt' AND contype = 'u') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_financial_movements__direction' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_cheques__status' AND contype = 'c') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_installments__status' AND contype = 'c') AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the migration back. After successful production apply, recovery is forward-only: preserve Finance/Treasury history and issue a corrective migration rather than dropping integrity constraints or rewriting committed migration history. Independent/partial/expression Finance indexes remain Phase 03.07. finance_categories.gl_account_id -> gl_accounts(id) remains deferred to the Accounting constraint slice so Accounting receives its canonical target key within its own authorized scope. Over-allocation, Active Treasury validation, cheque/installment double-settlement protection, deterministic treasury locking, reversal/correction and posting effects remain later backend transaction rules.
